comparison_type: post-cutover reconstruction of retained legacy UI worker versus deployed backend
host: same Windows PC and Qdrant collection
legacy_path: one new python.exe scripts/retrieval-worker.py process per request
current_path: authenticated loopback POST /api/v1/command on persistent backend PID 14540
limitations: The retained legacy worker was executed now; these are not measurements recorded before deployment.
The retained legacy worker uses current retrieval code; Stage D altered RRF tie handling and nonfused deduplication, but these runs used semantic-only and BM25-only paths.
Runs were sequential and Qdrant cache state was not controlled or randomized.
Semantic legacy cold has one sample; p95 is not estimated. BM25 p95 with five samples is only a reference maximum.
No ingestion throughput, process RSS peak, or process-attributed VRAM peak was measured.
data_protection: read-only searches against an existing collection; no production SQLite or Qdrant writes
